reply: Yes. The rules should agree before anyone picks. The coordinator started lane timer-rules-conflict at 14:02 CST to make outcomes-mechanize-rules and git-ci-wait-checks-in agree. If the wording needs your word, it comes to you as one question. The check-in question waits for that lane's PR.
title: When a session waits on a reply to its message, may it set one timed check-in?
why: Recommended a: a lost message gets caught, and the check-in starts no program and writes no file.
